about.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 6 years of experience driving impact projects to successful completion while consistently meeting quality targets. I'm a game enthusiast who loves reading up on the latest trends and implementing them in my job. With previous experience in startups, I bring development management skills, excelling in crafting detailed project plans, managing development KPIs, and fostering effective communication among team members.

highlights: Shipped three titles to Google Play: Park Escape, Last Turn and Endless Merge 2048.
Built on Unity 6 with the full Unity Gaming Services stack, so progression and currency are server-owned rather than trusted to the device.
Runs the whole pipeline solo: design, build, live services, store release.
Designed a sustainable architecture for the socket and API layer of a live real-money product.
Built tools and pipelines that cut the team’s iteration time.
Cut download size with Cloud Content Delivery and Addressables; 20% improvement in app response time.
Launched Underground Waifus, an NFT TCG, on Steam, Epic Games Store and Android — 25% reduction in loading times.
Implemented locomotion for players, bots and creatures, designed for network synchronisation and reuse across actor types.
Built MOBA and battle-royale mechanics for 5v5, and the play-to-earn systems behind them.
Built multiplayer Ludo and the card game Court Piece for internal product integration; shipped Chess to Google Play.
Solved the turn-based multiplayer problems that actually bite: auto moves, turn indicators and the UI state around them.
Integrated Photon, Socket.IO, PlayFab and Firebase across the titles.
Shipped Beat Killer to Google Play: a rhythm game with no tapping, 30+ songs and 20+ dynamic backgrounds.
Researched genre demographics and market data to settle the gameplay direction before building it.
Integrated Firebase, the Facebook and Google SDKs, and AdMob.
